show.review.label: review by an owner
talk.label.author: Issue author
show.subtitle: The Plain Concepts Platform
show.active.label: the active Issue
talk.local.title:
You work with AI
on your PC.
talk.local.body: You supply context, review the change and give the next instruction.
talk.maturity.levels.title:
Adoption and maturity
are different.
talk.maturity.levels.body: A new agent does not change team practices. Maturity depends on standards, control and outcomes.
talk.maturity.areas.title: We assess four areas.
talk.maturity.areas.body: SDLC 35% · determinism 25% · control 20% · impact 20%. We assess team practices.
talk.evolution.instructions.title: Prompts → skills → agents.
talk.evolution.instructions.body: A prompt states the task. A skill keeps the procedure. An agent uses tools to carry it out.
talk.evolution.environment.title: Plugins → guardrails → Harness.
talk.evolution.environment.body: Plugins enforce tool limits. The Harness supplies context, commands and the rules of the repo.
talk.evolution.async.title: The next step is asynchronous.
talk.evolution.async.body: A repository event starts the work. The process continues after you leave the PC.
talk.platform.pillars.title:
Four repositories
carry the method.
talk.platform.phases.title:
Discovery → Foundations
→ Maintenance
talk.platform.phases.body: Early work builds the technical and agent base. With that in place, more effort goes into defining the product.
talk.foundations.stack.title: A shared technical baseline.
talk.foundations.stack.body: Frontend: Next.js, TypeScript, tokens. Backend: .NET, layers and slices.
talk.foundations.build.title: A guardrail fails the build.
talk.foundations.build.body: The linter blocks cross-layer dependencies. Widening the rule also needs a gate.
talk.foundations.behavior.title:
Specs and tests
pin observable behavior.
talk.foundations.behavior.body: Code changes need a spec update. A test must assert an observable result.
talk.foundations.owners.title:
Auth, data and CI
need an owner.
talk.foundations.owners.body: Authentication, migrations and integrations stop for review. Green tests do not suffice.
talk.harness.contents.title:
agent-harness
sets up the environment.
talk.harness.contents.body: pc-* skills, commands, agents, plugins and OpenSpec in the repo.
talk.harness.change.title: Proposal → specs → tasks → PR.
talk.harness.plugins.title: Plugins block unsafe tool calls.
talk.harness.plugins.body: Plugins reject forbidden actions before the tool runs. AGENTS.md carries the repo instructions.
talk.harness.shared.title:
The same Harness
on PC and CI.
talk.harness.shared.body: OpenCode reads the repo context on both. Forge centralizes access to the model.
talk.workflows.compile.title:
From Markdown
to GitHub Actions.
talk.workflows.compile.body: The prompt lives in .md. gh aw compile writes .lock.yml. Actions runs the result.
talk.workflows.router.title: One router for every event.
talk.workflows.router.body: Shell classifies and authorizes the event. It calls at most one worker, or none.
talk.workflows.hybrid.title: Jobs → agent → jobs.
talk.workflows.hybrid.body: Jobs prepare facts and validate allowed outputs. The agent can take a different path on each run.
talk.workflows.refine.title:
Refine: from Issue
to user story.
talk.workflows.refine.body: It reads code and context. It writes testable criteria and estimates the work.
talk.workflows.refineReturns.title: Refine asks or splits.
talk.workflows.refineReturns.body: The author's answers return to Refine. Large Issues split into smaller children.
talk.workflows.implement.title: Implement: code, checks and PR.
talk.workflows.implement.body: Prepare the Issue → /plan-goal → validate the patch → open PR. The worker stops there.
talk.workflows.gate.title:
CI supplies evidence.
Merge Gate decides.
talk.workflows.gate.body: The agent finds defects. Code computes risk and validates the verdict. Only the gate merges.
talk.workflows.returns.title: Fix or review → CI → gate.
talk.workflows.returns.body: A failure goes back for repair. Apply Review reads the full conversation. Each push reruns CI.
talk.workflows.returns.command: repair / Apply Review → CI → Merge Gate
talk.workflows.handoff.title: Each worker hands off and stops.
talk.workflows.handoff.body: CI dispatches the gate when done. Release is manual. Reconcile recovers missed events.
talk.health.dora.title: DORA: delivery and rework.
talk.health.dora.body: Deployment frequency, commit to production and rework. The collector has no production incident data.
talk.health.agent.title: Tokens and time for each run.
talk.health.agent.body: Count runs that reached the model. Report how many supplied data. Totals are a floor.
talk.health.people.title: Work that still needs a person.
talk.health.people.body: Pending review and blocked Issues by project. Keep bot PRs separate to show the human workload.
talk.health.improve.title: Audit sends work back to Refine.
talk.health.improve.body: A read-only audit files an Issue through the same route. Health measures the result of the change.
talk.system.title:
From a product Issue
to production.
talk.system.body: Product experts who do not code file small eligible Issues or bugs. They reach production without human supervision.
